name: Sweets!! -Oshioki Sweetie Fandisc-
original_name: Sweets!!－オシオキSweetieファンディスク－
source:
Unofficial school "Cosplay Club" members gather on an isolated island during summer vacations to put up a maid play. Club leader Rin loves three things most of all - inventing new costumes, teasing protagonist and having sex with him.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
